title: Track Concatenation
text: Concatenate tracks, 1 input, 1 output; {Number of input tracks to combine} sets the number of input track ports, {Source of output bus name}, {Specify an output bus name} sets the name of output and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: In1, In2,..., InN
ports.summary: Tracks to combine Simulink ® buses containing MATLAB ® structures

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: Combined tracks Simulink bus containing MATLAB structure

params.name: Number of input tracks to combine
params.values: Number of input track ports 2 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Source of output bus name
params.values: Source of output bus name Auto (default) | Property

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
